answer: The help center doesn't name any lenders that are outside the e-payoff network, so I can't give you that list; please contact a store for it. It only lists the network lenders: Bayline Credit Union, Northwind Auto Finance, Meridian Auto Loans, Pinewood Federal Credit Union, Lakeshore Bank, and Granite Bank, which joined on March 15, 2026. Customers with any other lender need to bring a payoff letter or sign form NW-LPA-1 so we can request one, which takes about 2 business days. NW-LPA-1 is for loans only; lease customers should use NW-LSE-1.
